messages:
rachel_pm: Heads up — Nimbus reached out about co-listing their quantized 7B on Azure Marketplace plus a CloudBridge SI bundle. They want a joint SKU and coordinated launch window. Need legal + eng + product + SI ops sync on terms and checklist.

samir_sales: +1. key ask from them: revenue share split, listing fees, and whether we can support their BYOW deployment variant.

ellie_legal: Quick flags: export control for some quantized builds (check jurisdiction), must confirm license permits marketplace hosting vs. download, and we need a simple MOU before any marketing collateral.

joel_eng: Tech notes: runtime-wise we can serve the quantized variant but need to validate kernel stability on our current 4xA100 pool. Also need to confirm the model's licensing allows our optimizations (quant) to be published as a hosted offering.

maya_partners: SI ops checklist draft: 1) integration runbook, 2) config manifest for CloudBridge connectors, 3) validation prompts + perf targets, 4) rollback plan, 5) support SLAs. I'll share a template.

rachel_pm: @ellie_legal can you confirm whether the license requires attribution language on the marketplace tile? Need to know for copy + legal badge.

ellie_legal: Yes — they are under a permissive license but with attribution + no-endorsement clause. We'll draft the copy; also adding a clause for export geoblocking if requested.

joel_eng: FYI: quick smoke test I ran on staging: quantized model serves but has a 7–10% latency uplift at 1024 tokens under our batching config. Might need a custom kernel tweak or a different batching profile for that SKU.

samir_sales: For commercial terms: Nimbus proposed 70/30 rev split (them/Redwood) for hosted usage, flat listing fee waived if we commit to a 6‑month featured placement. Thoughts?

maya_partners: Proposed launch cadence: 2 weeks for legal + SOW, 1 week for eng validation, 1 week for SI integration test, then 1 week embargoed marketing. Total ~5 weeks if no blockers.

rachel_pm: OK — action items: @ellie_legal draft MOU + attribution copy (due EOD Wed), @joel_eng run perf matrix and confirm if kernel tweak required (due Fri), @maya_partners share SI checklist template and proposed SOW outline (tomorrow). Samir to push commercial proposal back to Nimbus with our counters.

deploy-bot: Reminder: please fill out the Partner Launch checklist in #partners-ops before the SOW is signed. :clipboard:

samir_sales: I'll ping Nimbus with the proposed cadence and ask for any geo restrictions.

rachel_pm: Thanks all — if anything urgent, let's spin a quick 20m sync tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
